text: Establish the standing identity, payment, and compute-spending mandate for the bounty agent
description: Felix chooses the legal/payment recipient, approves a dedicated disclosed agent-run Git identity, accepts any binding platform or contributor terms, sets the per-attempt compute cap and prohibited work, chooses the bounty allocation policy, and retains emergency revocation. Record the mandate in inspectable project state. This is institution-building, not per-task supervision; after it exists, qualifying issue selection, implementation, draft PR submission, review iteration, and compute reinvestment may proceed without step-by-step approval within the mandate.

status.comment: Requires Felix to establish legal identity, payment receipt, standing external-posting authority, spending limits, prohibited domains, and revocation. The agent must not invent or self-grant these powers.

valueRationale: A durable standing mandate converts repeated ad hoc human approvals into one legitimate boundary for autonomous economic action.
